turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Good morning, what brings you in today?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I've had a dull chest tightness for about three days, mostly when I walk upstairs.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does it spread anywhere, and does resting make it settle?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It goes into my left arm a little, and yes it eases off after a few minutes of sitting.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any shortness of breath, sweating, or nausea with it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: A bit breathless, no sweating. I take amlodipine five milligrams for blood pressure.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Thank you. We'll get an ECG and some bloods, including a troponin, now.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Is it my heart? Should I be worried?

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: We're checking to be safe. The tests take about an hour and I'll review them with you.
